facts.material: PA6-imide polyamide thermoplastic, no reinforcements or fillers
facts.function: feedstock for material-extrusion additive manufacturing (3D printing)
facts.form: extruded monofilament, solid circular cross-section, 1.75 mm diameter, on spools

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3916 covers monofilament of plastics of which any cross-sectional dimension exceeds 1 mm; 1.75 mm diameter qualifies
Section XI / chapter 54 exclude monofilament exceeding 1 mm cross-section, so not synthetic filament yarn of 5404
GRI 5(b): spools are ordinary packing/holding devices, classified with the filament
GRI 6: 3916.90 of other plastics (polyamide); other; other (not racket strings); 3916.90.30.00 monofilament

rejected_alternatives.reason: synthetic monofilament of 67 decitex or more with cross-section not exceeding 1 mm; this filament is 1.75 mm
covers rods, sticks and profile shapes; the article is a monofilament
not a primary form; it is an extruded monofilament

classification.rationale: The PA6-imide product is an extruded polyamide monofilament 1.75 mm in diameter, which exceeds 1 mm, so heading 3916 covers it rather than the textile monofilament provisions of chapter 54. The spools are ordinary holding devices. CBP classified 3D-printing filament of another plastic (PEEK) as monofilament in 3916.90.3000 (N356246, in force). The polyamide filament falls in 3916.90.30.00.
